# 3.3.7 Redundant Entry (Level A)

- Principle: 3 Understandable
- Guideline: 3.3 Input Assistance
- Level: A
- Versions: 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/redundant-entry.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#redundant-entry

## Normative text

Information previously entered by or provided to the user that is required to be entered again in the same [process](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-processes) is either:

- auto-populated, or
- available for the user to select.

Except when:

- re-entering the information is [essential](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-essential),
- the information is required to ensure the security of the content, or
- previously entered information is no longer valid.

## Sufficient techniques

- G221: Provide data from a previous step in a process
- Not requesting the same information twice (Potential future technique)
